senses: as adv. of time, before, formerly (cl.; [[r:3MA.5.28|3Ma 5:28]] [[r:3MAC.6.4|3Mac 6:4]] [[r:3MAC.6.31|3Mac 6:31]])

after a positive sentence, with accusative and inf.: [[r:MAT.26.34|Mat 26:34, 75]], [[r:MRK.14.72|Mrk 14:72]], [[r:LUK.22.61|Luk 22:61]], [[r:JHN.4.49|Jhn 4:49 8:58]] (where D. om. γενέσθαι and π. becomes prep. with genitive; see Bl., § 69, 7) [[r:JHN.14.29|Jhn 14:29]], [[r:ACT.2.20|Act 2:20]]" (LXX), WH, txt.; πρὶν ἤ (not such good Attic in this construction; see Bl., l.with), [[r:MAT.1.18|Mat 1:18]] [[r:MRK.14.30|Mrk 14:30]], [[r:ACT.2.20|Act 2:20]], WH, mg., [[r:ACT.7.2|Act 7:2]];
after a negative sentence, πρὶν ἤ: a. subjc. (before ἄν, M, Pr., 169), [[r:LUK.2.26|Luk 2:26]]; with optative, [[r:ACT.25.16|Act 25:16.]]† (AS)

G4226.root: genitive case of an interrogative pronoun πός (what) otherwise obsolete (perhaps the same as [[w:G4225]] used with the rising slide of inquiry)
G4226.strongs: as adverb of place; at (by implication, to) what locality
senses: In colloq. (as in Eng.) = ποῖ, whither: in direct questions, [[r:JHN.7.35|Jhn 7:35 9:12 13:36 16:5]]; in indir. quest., [[r:JHN.3.8|Jhn 3:8 8:14 12:35 14:5]], [[r:HEB.11.8|Heb 11:8]], [[r:1JN.2.11|1Jn 2:11]].† (AS)

G4254.strongs: to lead forward (magisterially); intransitively, to precede (in place or time (participle, previous))
senses: prop. trans., to lead on, lead forth or forward: with accusative of person(s), [[r:ACT.16.30|Act 16:30 17:5]]; of bringing forth to trial, [[r:ACT.12.6|Act 12:6]] (WH, txt., προσάγ-); before ἐπί, with genitive of person(s), [[r:ACT.25.26|Act 25:26.]]
Intrans. (Plat., Polyb., and later writers; see Bl., § 53, 1; MM, xxi);

to lead the way, [[r:1TI.1.18|1Ti 1:18]] (R, mg.), hence, to go before, precede: [[r:LUK.18.39|Luk 18:39]]; opposite to ἀκολουθέω, [[r:MRK.11.9|Mrk 11:9]]; before εἰς, [[r:MAT.14.22|Mat 14:22]], [[r:MRK.6.45|Mrk 6:45]], [[r:1TI.5.24|1Ti 5:24]], [[r:HEB.7.18|Heb 7:18]]; with accusative of person(s), [[r:MAT.2.9|Mat 2:9 21:9]], [[r:MRK.10.32|Mrk 10:32]]; before εἰς, [[r:MAT.21.31|Mat 21:31 26:32 28:7]], [[r:MRK.14.28|Mrk 14:28 16:7]];

G4215.root: probably from a derivative of the alternate of [[w:G4095]] (compare [[w:G4224]])
G4215.strongs: a current, brook or freshet (as drinkable), i.e. running water

G4241.strongs: to tower up (be conspicuous), i.e. (by implication) to be suitable or proper (third person singular present indicative, often used impersonally, it is fit or right)
senses: to be fitting or becoming, to suit: with dative, [[r:HEB.7.26|Heb 7:26]], [[r:1TI.2.10|1Ti 2:10]], [[r:TIT.2.1|Tit 2:1]]; impers., with dative, [[r:EPH.5.3|Eph 5:3]]; id. before inf., [[r:HEB.2.10|Heb 2:10]]; πρέπον ἐστίν, with dative of person(s) and inf., [[r:MAT.3.15|Mat 3:15]]; with accusative and inf., [[r:1CO.11.13|1Co 11:13]] (see Bl., § 72, 5).† (AS)

a foot, both of men and beasts: [[r:MAT.4.6|Mat 4:6]] (LXX), [[r:MRK.9.45|Mrk 9:45]], [[r:LUK.1.79|Luk 1:79]], [[r:JHN.11.44|Jhn 11:44]], [[r:ACT.7.5|Act 7:5]], al.; ὑπο τοὺς π., [[r:ROM.16.20|Rom 16:20]], [[r:1CO.15.25|1Co 15:25 15:27]] [[r:EPH.1.22|Eph 1:22]], [[r:HEB.2.8|Heb 2:8]]; ὑποκάτω τῶν π., [[r:MAT.22.44|Mat 22:44]] (LXX); πρὸς (παρὰ) τοὺς π., [[r:MRK.5.22|Mrk 5:22]], [[r:LUK.8.41|Luk 8:41]], al.; figuratively, [[r:MAT.15.30|Mat 15:30]], [[r:LUK.10.39|Luk 10:39]], [[r:ACT.5.2|Act 5:2]], al.; ἔμπροσθεν τῶν π., [[r:REV.3.9|Rev 3:9 19:10]], al.; ἐπὶ τοὺς π., [[r:ACT.10.25|Act 10:25.]] By meton., of a person in motion ([[r:PSA.119.101|Psa 119:101]]): [[r:LUK.1.79|Luk 1:79]], [[r:ACT.5.9|Act 5:9]], [[r:ROM.3.15|Rom 3:15 10:15]], [[r:HEB.12.13|Heb 12:13]] (AS)

G4260.strongs: to walk forward, i.e. advance (literally, or in years)
G4260.kjv: + be of a great age, go farther (on), be well stricken
senses: προ-βαίνω to go forwards, go on, advance: [[r:MAT.4.21|Mat 4:21]], [[r:MRK.1.19|Mrk 1:19]]. Metaphorical, of age ([[r:GEN.18.11|Gen 18:11]], al., Lys., Diod., al.), ἐν τ. ἡμέραις, [[r:LUK.1.7|Luk 1:7, 18 2:36]].† (AS)
(Or πρᾶος, ν. Bl., § 3, 3), -α, -ον (see LS, Thayer, see word), gentle, meek: [[r:MAT.5.5|Mat 5:5 11:29 21:5]]" (LXX) [[r:1PE.3.4|1Pe 3:4.]]† (AS)

G4253.strongs: "fore", i.e. in front of, prior (figuratively, superior) to
senses: of time: [[r:MAT.8.29|Mat 8:29 24:38]], [[r:LUK.11.38|Luk 11:38 21:12]], [[r:JHN.11.55|Jhn 11:55 13:1 17:24]], [[r:ACT.5.36|Act 5:36 21:38]], [[r:1CO.2.7|1Co 2:7 4:5]], [[r:EPH.1.4|Eph 1:4]], [[r:COL.1.17|Col 1:17]], [[r:2TI.1.9|2Ti 1:9 4:21]], [[r:TIT.1.2|Tit 1:2]], [[r:HEB.11.5|Heb 11:5]], [[r:1PE.1.20|1Pe 1:20]], Ju 25; π. ἐτῶν δεκατεσσάρων, fourteen years ago, [[r:2CO.12.2|2Co 12:2]]; π. προσώπου (see supr.), [[r:ACT.13.24|Act 13:24]]; with genitive of person(s), [[r:MAT.5.12|Mat 5:12]], [[r:JHN.5.7|Jhn 5:7 10:8]], [[r:ROM.16.7|Rom 16:7]], [[r:GAL.1.17|Gal 1:17]]; with genitive art. inf. (= πρίν; M, Pr., 100; Bl., § 69, 7), [[r:MAT.6.8|Mat 6:8]] [[r:LUK.2.21|Luk 2:21 22:15]], [[r:JHN.1.49|Jhn 1:49 13:19 17:5]], [[r:ACT.23.15|Act 23:15]], [[r:GAL.2.12|Gal 2:12 3:23]]; as in late writers (resembling a Latin idiom but indepen­dent of it; B1., § 40, 5; M, Pr., 100 f.; of. Am [[r:2MA.15.36|2Ma 15:36]], and for other exx., Soph., Lex., see word), πρὸ ἓξ ἡμέρας τοῦ πάσχα, on the sixth day before the Passover, [[r:JHN.12.1|Jhn 12:1]]; (with) of preference: π. πάντων, [[r:JAS.5.12|Jas 5:12]], [[r:1PE.4.8|1Pe 4:8]];

in compos., α with subst., of position before: προαύλιον, πρόδρομος; priority of rank or order, προπάτωρ; anticipation, πρό γνωσις, πρό νοια; β with adj., intensity, πρόδηλος; γ with verb., of place, προάγω, προβαίνω; of preference, προαιρέομαι.† (AS)

G4202.strongs: harlotry (including adultery and incest); figuratively, idolatry

G4214.root: from an absolute πός (who, what) and [[w:G3739]]
G4214.strongs: interrogative pronoun (of amount) how much (large, long or (plural) many)
senses: adj. of number, magnitude, degree, etc., how much, how great, how many: [[r:MAT.6.23|Mat 6:23]], [[r:2CO.7.11|2Co 7:11]]; of time, [[r:MRK.9.21|Mrk 9:21]]; neut., absol., [[r:LUK.16.5|Luk 16:5]], 7; dative, πόσῳ, adverbially, how much, [[r:MAT.12.12|Mat 12:12]]; id. before μᾶλλον, [[r:MAT.7.11|Mat 7:11 10:25]], [[r:LUK.11.13|Luk 11:13 12:24, 28]], [[r:ROM.11.12|Rom 11:12, 24]], Phm 16, [[r:HEB.9.14|Heb 9:14]]; π. χείρονος τιμωρίας, [[r:HEB.10.29|Heb 10:29]]; pl., [[r:MAT.15.34|Mat 15:34 16:9-10 27:13]], [[r:MRK.6.38|Mrk 6:38 8:5, 19-20 15:4]], [[r:LUK.15.17|Luk 15:17]], [[r:ACT.21.20|Act 21:20]].† (AS)

G4263.root: probably neuter of a presumed derivative of [[w:G4260]]
G4263.strongs: something that walks forward (a quadruped), i.e. (specially), a sheep (literally or figuratively)
senses: in Hom., Hdt., cattle, esp. of small cattle, sheep and goats.

In NT, as in Attic writers generally (cf. MM, xxi), a sheep: [[r:MAT.7.15|Mat 7:15]], [[r:MRK.6.34|Mrk 6:34]], al.; πρόβατα σφαγῆς, [[r:ROM.8.36|Rom 8:36]] (LXX). Metaphorical (in cl. of timidity, stupidity or idleness), of the followers of a leader or master, esp. of those who are subject to the care of the Good Shepherd: [[r:MAT.10.6|Mat 10:6 15:24 26:31]]" (LXX) [[r:MRK.14.27|Mrk 14:27]] (LXX), [[r:JHN.10.7|Jhn 10:7-8, 15-16 10:26-27 21:16-17]] (WH txt., προβάτια), [[r:HEB.13.20|Heb 13:20]]; opposite to ἐρίφια, [[r:MAT.25.33|Mat 25:33.]] προβάτιον, -ου, τό, dimin. of πρόβατον (used as a term of endearment, see El., § 27, 4), a little sheep: [[r:JHN.21.16|Jhn 21:16-17]] (πρόβατα, WH, mg.).† (AS)

G4217.root: apparently from [[w:G4219]] and the base of [[w:G4226]]
G4217.strongs: interrogatively, whatever, i.e. of what possible sort

G4222.root: from a derivative of the alternate of [[w:G4095]]
senses: (πότος), to give to drink: with accusative of person(s), [[r:MAT.25.35|Mat 25:35, 37 25:42 27:48]], [[r:MRK.15.36|Mrk 15:36]], [[r:LUK.13.15|Luk 13:15]], [[r:ROM.12.20|Rom 12:20]]; with dupl. accusative, [[r:MAT.10.42|Mat 10:42]], [[r:MRK.9.41|Mrk 9:41]]; fig., γάλα, [[r:1CO.3.2|1Co 3:2]]; ἐκ τ. οἴνου [[r:REV.14.8|Rev 14:8]]; of plants, to water (Xen., Strab., al.; [[r:GEN.13.10|Gen 13:10]]), figuratively, [[r:1CO.3.6|1Co 3:6-8]] Metaphorical (cf. [[r:ISA.29.10|Isa 29:10]] [[r:SIR.15.3|Sir 15:3]]), of the Spirit, [[r:1CO.12.13|1Co 12:13.]]† (AS)

G4221.root: neuter of a derivative of the alternate of [[w:G4095]]
G4221.strongs: a drinking-vessel; by extension, the contents thereof, i.e. a cupful (draught); figuratively, a lot or fate
senses: (πίνω), a wine cup: [[r:MAT.23.25|Mat 23:25-26 26:27]], [[r:MRK.7.4|Mrk 7:4 14:23]], [[r:LUK.11.39|Luk 11:39 22:17, 20]] a (WH, R, mg., cm.), [[r:1CO.11.25|1Co 11:25]], [[r:REV.17.4|Rev 17:4]]; πίνειν ἐκ τοῦ π., [[r:1CO.11.28|1Co 11:28]]; with genitive of thing(s), [[r:MAT.10.42|Mat 10:42]], [[r:MRK.9.41|Mrk 9:41]]; τ. εὐλογίας, [[r:1CO.10.16|1Co 10:16]]; by meton., of the contents of the cup, [[r:LUK.22.20|Luk 22:20]] b (WH, R, mg., cm.), [[r:1CO.11.25|1Co 11:25-26]]; with genitive of person(s), [[r:1CO.10.21|1Co 10:21 11:27]]. Metaphorical, of experience of divine providence; of prosperity ([[r:PSA.16.5|Psa 16:5]], al.); of adversity ([[r:PSA.11.6|Psa 11:6]], [[r:ISA.51.17|Isa 51:17]], al.): of the sufferings of Christ, [[r:MAT.20.22|Mat 20:22-23 26:39 10:38-39 14:36]], [[r:LUK.22.42|Luk 22:42]], [[r:JHN.18.11|Jhn 18:11]]; of divine punishment, [[r:REV.14.10|Rev 14:10 16:19 18:6]].† (AS)

G4286.strongs: a setting forth, i.e. (figuratively) proposal (intention); specially, the show-bread (in the Temple) as exposed before God
senses: a setting forth (Plat., Plut., al.): οἱ ἄρτοι τῆς π. (cf. LXX, ll. with, elsewhere ἄρτοι ἐνώπιοι, [[r:EXO.25.29|Exo 25:29]]; οἱ ἄ. τοῦ προσώπου, [[r:NEH.10.33|Neh 10:33]]), [[r:MAT.12.4|Mat 12:4]], [[r:MRK.2.26|Mrk 2:26]], [[r:LUK.6.4|Luk 6:4]]; ἡ π. τῶν ἄρτων, [[r:HEB.9.2|Heb 9:2.]]

G4264.root: from [[w:G4253]] and a reduplicated form of [[w:G0971]]
G4264.strongs: to force forward, i.e. bring to the front, instigate
senses: προ-βιβάζω causal of προβαίνω, to lead forward, lead on; metaphorically, to induce, incite, urge: [[r:MAT.14.8|Mat 14:8.]]† (AS)

G4245.strongs: older; as noun, a senior; specially, an Israelite Sanhedrist (also figuratively, member of the celestial council) or Christian "presbyter"
senses: πρέσβυς, -εως, ὁ poët. form of πρεσβύτης (which see), an old man. Compar., πρεσβύτερος, -α, -ον,

of age, elder: ὁ νἱὸς ὁ π., [[r:LUK.15.25|Luk 15:25]]; as subst., opposite to νεανίσκοι, [[r:ACT.2.17|Act 2:17]]; to νεώτερος, [[r:1TI.5.1|1Ti 5:1-2]]; of the religious leaders of the past, [[r:MAT.15.2|Mat 15:2]], [[r:MRK.7.3|Mrk 7:3]], 5, [[r:HEB.11.2|Heb 11:2]] (= οἱ πατέρες, [[r:HEB.1.1|Heb 1:1]]).
Of dignity, rank or office (as found in π. and Inscr. of civil and religious offices, including priesthood, in Asia Minor and in Egypt; see Deiss., BS, 154 ff., 233 If.; LAE, 373);

among Christians: [[r:ACT.11.30|Act 11:30 14:23 15:2, 4 15:6, 22-23 16:4 21:18]], [[r:1TI.5.17|1Ti 5:17 5:19]], [[r:TIT.1.5|Tit 1:5]], II Jn 1, 3Jn 1, [[r:1PE.5.1|1Pe 5:1 5:5]]; τ. ἐκκλησίας, [[r:ACT.20.17|Act 20:17]], [[r:JAS.5.14|Jas 5:14]]; (with) in the visions of the Apocalypse: [[r:REV.4.4|Rev 4:4, 10 5:5-6, 8 5:11, 14 7:11, 13 11:16 14:3 19:4]]. (On the NT use of this word and its relation to ἐπίσκοπος (which see), cf. Lft., Phi., 93 ff., 189 ff.; CGT, Past. Epp., lvi ff.) † (AS)
πόρρω adv. (in older Attic, πρόσω), far off: [[r:MAT.15.8|Mat 15:8]], [[r:MRK.7.6|Mrk 7:6]]" (LXX), [[r:LUK.14.32|Luk 14:32]]; comparat., πορρώτερον (-ρω, T), [[r:LUK.24.28|Luk 24:28.]]† (AS)

G4234.strongs: practice, i.e. (concretely) an act; by extension, a function
senses: a doing, deed, act: [[r:MAT.16.27|Mat 16:27]]; pl., π. ἀποσπτόλων, Ac, title; in late writers especially of wicked deeds or practices (frequently in Polyb.): [[r:LUK.23.51|Luk 23:51]]; p1., [[r:ROM.8.13|Rom 8:13]], [[r:COL.3.9|Col 3:9]]; with ref. to magic (see BS, 3235), [[r:ACT.19.18|Act 19:18.]]

G4229.strongs: a deed; by implication, an affair; by extension, an object (material)
senses: that which has been done, a deed, act: [[r:LUK.1.1|Luk 1:1]], [[r:ACT.5.4|Act 5:4]], [[r:2CO.7.11|2Co 7:11]], [[r:HEB.6.18|Heb 6:18]].

That which is being done (like Lat. res), hence, a thing, matter, affair: [[r:MAT.18.19|Mat 18:19]], [[r:ROM.16.2|Rom 16:2]], [[r:1TH.4.6|1Th 4:6]] (see M, Th., in l), [[r:HEB.10.1|Heb 10:1 11:1]], [[r:JAS.3.16|Jas 3:16]]; in forensic sense (as frequently in π., see Deiss., BS, 233), a law-suit: [[r:1CO.6.1|1Co 6:1.]]† (AS)

a prostitute, harlot: [[r:MAT.21.31|Mat 21:31-32]], [[r:LUK.15.30|Luk 15:30]], [[r:1CO.6.15|1Co 6:15-16]] [[r:HEB.11.31|Heb 11:31]], [[r:JAS.2.25|Jas 2:25]]. Metaphorical (see Swete, Ap., 180 f.), of Babylon (i.e. Rome): [[r:REV.17.1|Rev 17:1, 5 17:15-16 19:2]].† (AS)

G4281.strongs: to go onward, precede (in place or time)
G4281.kjv: go before (farther, forward), outgo, pass on
senses: to go forward, go on, advance: before μικρόν, [[r:MAT.26.39|Mat 26:39]] and [[r:MRK.14.35|Mrk 14:35]] (WH, mg., προσελθών): ῥύμην μίαν (cf. Plat., Rep., i, 328e), [[r:ACT.12.10|Act 12:10.]]

Of relative position, to go before, precede: with genitive (cl.; Jth, l.with); with accusative of person(s) (not cl.), [[r:LUK.22.47|Luk 22:47]] (with genitive, Rec.); before ἐνώπιον, [[r:LUK.1.17|Luk 1:17]] (cf. [[r:GEN.33.3|Gen 33:3]]).
Of time, to go before or in advance: [[r:ACT.20.5|Act 20:5, 13]] (WH, mg., R, mg.), [[r:2CO.9.5|2Co 9:5]]; with accusative of person(s) (= cl. φθάνω), [[r:MRK.6.33|Mrk 6:33.]]† (AS)

G4289.strongs: forward in spirit, i.e. predisposed; neuter (as noun) alacrity
senses: willing, ready: [[r:MAT.26.41|Mat 26:41]], [[r:MRK.14.38|Mrk 14:38]]; neut., τὸ π. = ἡ προθυμία (Thuc., al., [[r:3MA.5.26|3Ma 5:26]]), οὕτως τὸ κατ᾽ ἐμὲ (= cl. τὸ ἐμὸν) π., [[r:ROM.1.15|Rom 1:15]] (but see ICC, in l).† (AS)

G4232.strongs: the prætorium or governor's courtroom (sometimes including the whole edifice and camp)
senses: The palace or official residence of the Governor of a province: [[r:MAT.27.27|Mat 27:27]], [[r:MRK.15.16|Mrk 15:16]] (see Swete, in l), [[r:JHN.18.28|Jhn 18:28, 33 19:9]]; τ. π. τ. Ἡρώδου, [[r:ACT.23.35|Act 23:35.]]
the Prætorian Guard: [[r:PHP.1.13|Php 1:13]] (see Lft., in l; ICC, 51 f.).† (AS)

G4237.root: perhaps from πράσον (a leek, and so an onion-patch)
G4237.strongs: a garden plot, i.e. (by implication, of regular beds) a row (repeated in plural by Hebraism, to indicate an arrangement)
senses: a garden-bed; metaphorically, of ranks or orderly groups of persons: [[r:MRK.6.40|Mrk 6:40.]]† (AS)

G4259.root: neuter of a presumed compound of [[w:G4253]] and [[w:G0833]]

G4209.strongs: the "purple" mussel, i.e. (by implication) the red-blue color itself, and finally a garment dyed with it

G4225.root: genitive case of an indefinite pronoun πός (some) otherwise obsolete (compare [[w:G4214]])
G4225.strongs: as adverb of place, somewhere, i.e. nearly
senses: in some degree, perhaps, about: [[r:ACT.27.29|Act 27:29]] (T, μήπου), [[r:ROM.4.19|Rom 4:19]]; δή που (T, δήπου), surely: [[r:HEB.2.16|Heb 2:16.]]† (AS)

G4246.forms: πρεσβύτης, -ου prose form of πρέσβυς, which see
senses: an old man: [[r:LUK.1.18|Luk 1:18]], [[r:TIT.2.2|Tit 2:2]], Phm 9 (R, txt., but see infr.).
As in LXX, also = πρεσβευτής, an am­bassador: Phm 9 (R, mg., see Lft. and ICC, in l).† (AS)

G4298.strongs: to drive forward (as if by beating), i.e. (figuratively and intransitively) to advance (in amount, to grow; in time, to be well along)
G4298.kjv: increase, proceed, profit, be far spent, wax
senses: προ-κόπτω to cut forward a way, for­ward, advance, in cl. trans. with neut. adj., as οὐδὲν π., τὰ πολλὰ π. In late writers (Polyb., al.), wholly intrans., to advance, progress: of time, [[r:ROM.13.12|Rom 13:12.]] Metaphorical, [[r:LUK.2.52|Luk 2:52]], [[r:GAL.1.14|Gal 1:14]], [[r:2TI.2.16|2Ti 2:16 3:9 3:13]].† (AS)

G4238.strongs: to "practise", i.e. perform repeatedly or habitually (thus differing from, which properly refers to a single act); by implication, to execute, accomplish, etc.; specially, to collect (dues), fare (personally)
G4238.kjv: commit, deeds, do, exact, keep, require, use arts
senses: πράσσω (Att.. -ττω, and so [[r:ACT.17.7|Act 17:7]] Rec.; cf. M, Pr., 25, 45), = Lat agere, as ποιέω (which see) = facere,

to do, practise, be engaged in: [[r:ACT.19.19|Act 19:19, 36]], [[r:1CO.9.17|1Co 9:17]]; τ. ἴδια π., to mind one's own business (τὰ ἑαυτοῦ, Soph., Plat.), [[r:1TH.4.11|1Th 4:11]]; intrans., to act, [[r:ACT.17.7|Act 17:7.]]
to transact, manage, hence, of payment, to exact (cl.): [[r:LUK.3.13|Luk 3:13 19:23]].
Reflexively, of state or condition, to do or fare Æsch., Hdt., al.): [[r:EPH.6.21|Eph 6:21]]; εὖ π. (see M, Pr., 228 f.), [[r:ACT.15.29|Act 15:29.]]† SYN.: see: ποιέω (AS)

G4273.root: from [[w:G4272]] (in the sense of giving forward into another's (the enemy's) hands)

G4233.strongs: a practiser, i.e. (specially), an official collector
senses: In Athens, one who exacts payment, a collector; hence, generally (frequently in π., see Deiss., BS, 154), a court officer: [[r:LUK.12.58|Luk 12:58.]]† (AS)

G4242.strongs: seniority (eldership), i.e. (by implication) an embassy (concretely, ambassadors)
senses: an embassy; by meton., of the am­bassadors, embassy: [[r:LUK.14.32|Luk 14:32 19:14]].† (AS)

G4207.root: from [[w:G4206]] with adverbial enclitic of source
G4207.strongs: from far, or (by implication) at a distance, i.e. distantly

G4231.strongs: to busy oneself with, i.e. to trade
senses: to be engaged in business, esp. to trade: [[r:LUK.19.13|Luk 19:13]] (cf. δια-πραγματεύομαι).† (AS)

G4261.strongs: to throw forward, i.e. push to the front, germinate
senses: to put forward: with accusative, [[r:ACT.19.33|Act 19:33]]; of trees, to put forth, produce (sc. φύλλα), [[r:LUK.21.30|Luk 21:30.]]† (AS)

G4218.strongs: indefinite adverb, at some time, ever
G4218.kjv: afore-(any, some-)time(-s), at length (the last), (+ n-)ever, in the old time, in time past, once, when

G4262.strongs: relating to sheep, i.e. (a gate) through which they were led into Jerusalem
senses: (πρόβατον) of sheep: ἡ π. (sc. πύλη, see supr.), the sheep-gate, [[r:JHN.5.2|Jhn 5:2.]]† (AS)

senses: Trans., to hold before; mid., to hold something before oneself (Hdt.), hence, metaphorically, to excuse oneself: [[r:ROM.3.9|Rom 3:9]], R, mg. (but see Field, Notes, 152 f.; Lft., Notes, 266 f.; ICC and Vau., in l).
in running, to have the start, hence, metaphorically, to excel: pass., Ro, l.with, R, txt. (see reff. supr.).† (AS)

G4256.strongs: to accuse already, i.e. previously charge

G4272.strongs: to give before the other party has given
senses: to give before, give first: [[r:ROM.11.35|Rom 11:35]] ([[r:JOB.41.2|Job 41:2]] (11) LXX, al.).

G4291.strongs: to stand before, i.e. (in rank) to preside, or (by implication) to practise
senses: trans. in fut., 1 aor., and mid. 1 aor., to put before, set over (Plat., al.).
Intrans., in pf., plpf., 2 aor. and mid. Pres. and impf.;

G4270.strongs: to write previously; figuratively, to announce, prescribe

= ζωγραφέω, to pourtray, depict: Ga, l.with (Syr. Pesh., Chrys.; Field, Notes, 189; CGT, in l).† (AS)

G4243.strongs: to be a senior, i.e. (by implication) act as a representative (figuratively, preacher)

to present oneself, be present: [[r:2CO.8.12|2Co 8:12]] (see Mey., in l).† (AS)

G4283.strongs: to announce glad news in advance

G4292.strongs: to call forth to oneself (challenge), i.e. (by implication) to irritate
senses: προ-καλέω, -ῶ to call forth. Most frequently in mid.,

G4276.strongs: to hope in advance of other confirmation

πρό-κριμα, -τος, τό (cl. προκρίνειν, 1. to prefer. 2. to judge beforehand), pre-judging, prejudice: [[r:1TI.5.21|1Ti 5:21]] (see Cremer, 378).† (AS)

G4271.strongs: plain before all men, i.e. obvious
